headline: Two, and the cup is still there.
body: The ledge holds the same cup, cooler now, a ring under it. Traffic on the side street has settled into a single note. We leave the window open a finger and call the hour ordinary.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: still pale, a little more haze west

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: past the hard noon, brick warming

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: cup unclaimed, side street one note
